      <article class="review-article">
        <div class="review-header">
          <h2>Overview</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="review-content">
          <p>
            This research review examines the role of shaft flexibility in the dynamics of the golf swing. The flexibility 
            of the golf club shaft significantly affects how forces are transmitted, how the clubhead moves, and ultimately 
            how the ball behaves at impact. Understanding these effects is crucial for club fitting, swing optimization, 
            and understanding the physics of the golf swing.
          </p>
          <p>
            <strong>Key Research Focus:</strong> How shaft stiffness, flex profile, and material properties influence 
            swing mechanics, clubhead speed, impact conditions, and ball flight characteristics.
          </p>
        </div>
      </article>

        </div>
        <div class="review-content">
          <h3>Shaft Stiffness and Flex Profile</h3>
          <p>
            Research on how shaft stiffness and flex profile affect:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Clubhead speed generation</li>
            <li>Shaft deflection patterns during the swing</li>
            <li>Timing of shaft loading and unloading</li>
            <li>Impact conditions and ball flight</li>
          </ul>

          <h3>Dynamic Shaft Behavior</h3>
          <p>
            Understanding how the shaft behaves dynamically during the swing:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Shaft bending and vibration modes</li>
            <li>Energy storage and release</li>
            <li>Interaction between shaft flexibility and swing mechanics</li>
            <li>Effects on clubhead path and face angle</li>
          </ul>

          <h3>Material Properties</h3>
          <p>
            Research on how shaft material properties influence performance:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Steel vs. graphite shafts</li>
            <li>Material stiffness and damping properties</li>
            <li>Weight distribution effects</li>
            <li>Modern composite materials</li>
          </ul>

          <h3>Club Fitting Applications</h3>
          <p>
            Practical applications for club fitting:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Matching shaft properties to swing characteristics</li>
            <li>Optimizing shaft selection for performance</li>
            <li>Understanding individual differences in shaft response</li>
            <li>Frequency matching and customization</li>
          </ul>

      <article class="review-article">

          <h2>Methodological Approaches</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="review-content">
          <p>
            Research on shaft flexibility has employed various methodological approaches:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Experimental Studies:</strong> Measuring shaft deflection and clubhead motion with different shaft properties</li>
            <li><strong>Computational Modeling:</strong> Finite element analysis and multibody dynamics simulations</li>
            <li><strong>Biomechanical Analysis:</strong> Combining motion capture with shaft measurements</li>
            <li><strong>Performance Testing:</strong> Measuring ball flight and impact conditions</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </article>
